texts.author: apex_concierge
texts.text:
Please do not share your UPI PIN, OTP, or any other sensitive payment details with us. We will never ask for this information, and for your security, please do not share it here or anywhere else.

Regarding your refund, I need to connect you with our orders team to look into the status of your payment. I am transferring you now.
